name: 共同編集者一覧の選択・種別検索帯
prompt:
Edit the previous generated image by tightly cropping away its large white top and bottom margins. Keep the control strip itself exactly as shown: same unchecked checkbox and 「すべて選択」 at the far left, 「種類」 dropdown with down caret at the far right, divider, and full-width 「共同編集者を検索...」 field with magnifier. Do not redraw, restyle, translate further, or change any controls.

Set the final image to the original crop’s 1024:140 aspect ratio (7.314:1), with the two-row strip filling the full canvas from edge to edge and no white margins around it. Match the source crop boundaries and row heights. The source is the geometry authority; use the previous candidate only for the correct localized contents.
reviewNotes: Candidate v002 retains the correct two-row controls and Japanese copy but still uses a 2172x724 (3.00:1) canvas against the 1024x140 (7.3143:1) source; SHA-256 fc03af96a4bb20036306fe42e4b23cbac8794935b6f1b95a774af9731079b699. It removes the top blank band but leaves a large blank area below the controls, so framing remains materially off. Two attempts used; status needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
